name: pac-bench-against-refusals
description: A safety-oriented benchmark that tests model behavior when prompted with inputs intended to elicit refusals or bypass safety guards. It measures whether models correctly refuse, safely respond, or incorrectly comply with harmful or disallowed requests. The dataset is intended to evaluate robustness of refusal policies and alignment behavior across language models.
reputation: A niche, experimental benchmark with limited but growing use in alignment and safety research communities.
